@dataclass
class MCPClientSpec:
    """Typed representation of a configured MCP client."""

    provider: str = "stub"
    module: Optional[str] = None
    class_name: Optional[str] = None
    parameters: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    optional: bool = False
